question: Does the actual native Wingless broker.Runner preserve external acceptance authority while bounding deterministic verifier-triggered repair to at most one attempt across healthy/unhealthy and authorization states?
matrix: All 2^7=128 Boolean combinations of fast_fixture_pass, allow_deep, max_repairs_one, deep_healthy, deep_fixture_pass, context_has_repair_headroom, allow_fallback. Exactly two registered native inference.Mock backends fast and deep with capability code; both are allowlisted. Their responses are fixed 'good' or 'bad' strings; fast health always good, deep health variable; fast and deep have zero Delay. Mock invoke is NOT real model inference.
native_runner: Call ACTUAL broker.Runner.Run with Registry of fast/deep, Metrics provider returning empty successful snapshot, trusted deterministic Verifier that verifies result.Text=='good' and otherwise returns fixed error 'fixture failed'. Every input Request valid and MaxContextBytes either1 (enough for only context='x') or4096 (enough for one appended diagnostic); deadlines +5min; Policy.Reason routine, AllowDeep,AllowFallback and MaxRepairs0/1 fixed by matrix.
independent_oracle: If fast passes, one attempt, verified_candidate. Else first fails. Only when max_repairs_one AND allow_deep AND context_has_repair_headroom is a second attempt permitted. If deep healthy select deep second: verified_candidate if deep passes, otherwise operator_blocked. If deep unhealthy but allow_fallback true select fast (fails again) second: operator_blocked. If deep unhealthy with no fallback, second selection denied, operator_blocked. All remaining blocked after1 attempt. Every outcome.Acceptance ALWAYS external_required; never a live authorization, even after verifier pass.
control: For each matrix fixture create a second native Runner with Verifier nil, maximum repairs0; its first healthy fast reply returns result_ready with acceptance external_required even if text bad. This is a control showing unverified candidate delivery is not verification, not an attack or false live acceptance.
metrics: Record per-case expected and observed native Status, Events length, route sequence, native event Verification values, acceptance, unverified-control status, first mismatches. Verify max2 attempts, no outcome.ACCEPTANCE different from external_required, no evidence of tool execution. All128 combinations deterministic original.
classification: NATIVE_VERIFIER_BOUNDARY if zero mismatches against prereg independent oracle and both verified and blocked cases occur and no acceptance authority changes. NEGATIVE_BOUNDARY_FAILURE otherwise. Preserve invalid/original errors; never rerun consumed first use.
safeguards: SHA-pinned exact broker/runner.go, original 128 source/prereg, original Actions artifact and full go test/build. No new runner implementation, no model calls, accepted-ref mutation, untrusted diagnostic authority or live activation.
claim_limit: Native Go orchestration with mock inference; verification/repair correctness does not show native reasoning capability or production-deployment safety.
